theorems.name_zh: 全端口质量签名与细作用类双射
theorems.assumptions: Positive stochastic ControlPacket; fixed controls; universal safe-lattice germ equivalence at target precision
theorems.law: Weighted row symmetry iff conjugation induces a bijection of refined positive-support action classes preserving their complete source-target mass signatures. Atomic bijection is unnecessary.
theorems.boundary: Fixed carrier and observer only; neither physical attribution nor full path/weight-histogram equivalence; one-layer affine form is not universal multi-layer closure.

theorems.name_zh: 聚合核一位修复的仿射纤维
theorems.assumptions: A fixed guarded projective seed modulo p^N, N=m+C>=1, p prime
theorems.law: All next-digit weighted-kernel lifts above this seed form an empty set or an affine F_p subspace of dimension at most35; no atom matching is fixed.
theorems.boundary: Fixed carrier and observer only; neither physical attribution nor full path/weight-histogram equivalence; one-layer affine form is not universal multi-layer closure.

theorems.name_zh: 配对置换的基本阿贝尔p群与等纤维
theorems.assumptions: The fiber in WM-002 is nonempty
theorems.law: Relative viable class permutations form an elementary abelian p-group; there are p^r viable matchings, each with p^(d-r) repairs. Complete matching enumeration plus inherited exact linear solvers gives the full affine fiber; incomplete search retains only a certified subset.
theorems.boundary: Fixed carrier and observer only; neither physical attribution nor full path/weight-histogram equivalence; one-layer affine form is not universal multi-layer closure.

theorems.name_zh: 可变配对增加修复自由度的六轴见证
theorems.assumptions: Declared p=2/p=3 repeated-pair integer ControlPacket, full6x6 frame corrections, fixed seed
theorems.law: The binary uniform two-class model has two disjoint2^26 matching fibers whose union is a27-dimensional family. Bias reduces it to26 dimensions. The ternary model has three3^26 fibers among six candidate matchings.
theorems.boundary: Fixed carrier and observer only; neither physical attribution nor full path/weight-histogram equivalence; one-layer affine form is not universal multi-layer closure.

theorems.name_zh: 原子匹配遗漏与细化质量分裂障碍
theorems.assumptions: D mass1/4; V and V(I+4E12) each1/8; stop1/2; repeated three pairs; J seed modulo4; p=2
theorems.law: No weight-preserving atomic matching accepts J, yet the weighted lift from germ depth1 to2 has2^17 repairs. Refining to depth3 splits the V-side into distinct1/8 classes and leaves no repair over this seed.
theorems.boundary: Fixed carrier and observer only; neither physical attribution nor full path/weight-histogram equivalence; one-layer affine form is not universal multi-layer closure.

theorems.name_zh: 残差分裂后的延迟首达可观察差
theorems.assumptions: The exact stopped ControlPackets and boundary observer in the report, fixed p=2
theorems.law: At threshold3 all-time first-passage laws coincide. At threshold4 their first differing coefficient is at step8:7/16384 versus57/131072; all-time risks1/97 versus11717/1135289. The positive path family D^3 W {V,W}^4 has mass1/131072.
theorems.boundary: Fixed carrier and observer only; neither physical attribution nor full path/weight-histogram equivalence; one-layer affine form is not universal multi-layer closure.
